Founder: 'the plumbing is there disable it for now until we can figure out a better idea.' Marked docs/CONTENT_TYPE_TAXONOMY.md with an explicit PAUSED marker so a future session doesn't silently re-attempt this and hit the same wall. All plumbing (RunnerConfig.SourceName, SourceProvider, poll-jitter flags, the webdriver/HTTP-client fixes) stays in place, dormant, safe defaults unchanged -- zero behavior change for live PRNewswire polling. Real unblock path: a residential/mobile proxy or non-datacenter IP, an infrastructure decision. Commit ec3a12a.

⚓ ☃
